rivalries.note: The Marathon: both legs went to sudden death (9,918 and 9,708 ticks) and both were decided by 4 HP. The 4-node minimalist Mote vs the Phase-0 champion Moth — neither could finish the other before the circle collapsed.
Biggest shock of the season: Tracker (novelty 0.706, finished #15) beat #2 Pulse by 4 HP for a +185.6 Elo swing in 275 ticks; Pulse took revenge on the other leg.
Poltergeist’s revenge-latch ambush game toppled the #2 seed Pulse (+150.6 Elo) in 862 ticks; Pulse answered on the open leg.
Banshee beat the eventual champion Drifter (+164.8 Elo) in 460 ticks; Drifter took the other leg on the way to the title.
The legacy Phase-0 Moth took a leg off the champion Drifter (+148.1 Elo) — the old king reminding the new one it still has teeth.
Occam’s 9,163-tick sudden-death comeback from a 72 HP deficit (+74.2 upset over Blackout); Blackout needed a shootout to answer on blocks.
The 7-node minimalist Occam upset the novelty-1.00 king Outlier (+155.3 Elo) in 266 ticks; Outlier answered on blocks.
Two minimalists, two circle-collapse grinds: both legs hit sudden death (9,721 and 10,284 ticks). The grindiest rivalry of the season.

highlights.title: Match of the season
highlights.note: Scalpel trailed Blackout by 126 HP, dragged the fight into sudden death, and won by 4 HP after 9,942 ticks — comeback, grind, nail-biter, and a +47.1 Elo upset all in one match.

highlights.title: Biggest upset
highlights.note: Tracker (+185.6 Elo swing) beat #2 Pulse by 4 HP in 275 ticks — the largest underdog win of the season.

highlights.title: Sudden-death war
highlights.note: Tracker vs Poltergeist needed a shootout just to get a decisive seed, then ground through 10,164 ticks of sudden death — Tracker by 10 HP.

highlights.title: Fastest KO
highlights.note: Survivor needed 253 ticks to put Tracker away — the quickest kill of the season.

highlights.title: Champion toppled
highlights.note: Banshee beat the eventual champion Drifter (+164.8 Elo) in 460 ticks — the highest-Elo scalp claimed all season.
